messages:
nina: Quick PR opened to clarify rate-limit headers and add a tiny migration note for `x-rw-consumption` parsing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6102

omar: Thanks — can you include a short curl + node snippet showing how to read the nested tiers? Many customers copy the python examples only.

sylvia: Also replace any hardcoded token price numbers with variables and link to the canonical pricing matrix. Legal asked for that.

nina: Added node + curl snippets and switched to variables. Also included a 2-line troubleshooting bullet: "If quota looks stale, wait 60s then requery."

infra-bot: INFRA-1087 filed to verify dashboard permalinks across regions; please include panel UID in the PR.

omar: Left an inline suggestion to prefer `consumption.summary` when present, then fall back to scanning `consumption.tiers`. Non-blocking.

sylvia: Approved after the minor wording tweak.

nina: Merged after CI green. Backport to release/1.0 queued. Posting a short note in #release-notes. Closing thread."
